mode: roads only with or without tracks; ferry omitted in this design for matched baseline
objective: maximise additional modelled population covered beyond all 26 existing hubs
assumptions: all 26 mapped existing hubs treated as available services
new centre assumed to offer same service without capacity limits
straight connector is an assumed off-network distance, not an observed road
candidate centres >=40km from mapped existing hubs
strict full-cell protected-area mask and point-sampled land-cover exclusion
one optimum only; location identity may not be unique
autonomy: water proximity is one necessary-resource proxy only; not water quality, energy, local transformation, jobs or measured independence
limits: no cadastral, slope, finance, hazard or displacement clearance
25km sampling omits Equateur and either grid may miss useful sites
WorldPop and GHSL are modelled population products
no inference that selected centres are buildable sovereign cities
